assemblySourceNote: I built the candidate before committing. Informational metadata retains the baseline commit; the source hashes and actual measured assembly hashes identify the final code.
hostLimits: Ordinary M4 scheduling across both core types, no affinity or quiet-host claim. The shared heavy-run lock serializes every workload; builds use two workers.

measurement.interpretation: One baseline bracketed by two candidates. CSV uses the identical unchanged binary in all three launches. Earlier bounded trial uses 32 invocations; the initial baseline and profiled runs are retained separately.

earlierHarnessNote: The initial baseline, profile and control trial use the original baseline harness. The stable bracket uses the exact candidate harness with both engine binaries; engine and Core hashes stay fixed.
validation: Every read participant materializes all four Excel columns or ten CSV fields and checks all values in preflight. Timed read and parse operations consume every field/record and return or check counts/checksums. Writes include generation, serialization, finalization and complete output bytes; strict OfficeIMO and independent reader checks validate every value. XLS Index/DBCell structure is also checked. The OfficeIMO typed-cell XLSB write is a separate diagnostic, outside parity ranking.

profile.collection: dotnet-trace 10.0.750501, sampled thread time and verbose GC, four OfficeIMO read/parse cases (XLSX/XLSB), 2 warmups, 4 samples, 256 invocations, under lock
profile.observations: String materialization, inflation and XML indexing remain leading costs; XLSB discovery still performs disabled optional row-plan calls after a layout change. Duplicate date conversion is not a leading sampled cost and remains unchanged. Managed sampling does not isolate native inflater CPU throughput. Counts from the GC-inclusive trace are not interpreted as uniform CPU samples; elapsed synthetic CPU/unmanaged intervals are retained separately.

compatibility.selectors: Unchanged; no writer or selector code changes
compatibility.validation: Discovery retains all record, position, style, string, cancellation and resource-budget checks. Only the optional row-layout observer is retired when it cannot produce a plan.
compatibility.testAuthoring: Existing stable-layout, changing-layout and trailing-empty-row boundary tests cover the change; no new or changed tests.
compatibility.review: I checked discovery, builder callers, fallback, validation, budgets and cancellation against the previous lifecycle.
limits: net472 cross-build only; no Windows runtime proof.
Host-dependent elapsed times do not establish a portable ranking.
Read validation still precedes delivery; raw and selector-based binary writer gaps remain.
